name: Paul Atreides
text:
You may look at the top card of your deck at any time.
[Action [Arrow]:] Discard the top card of your deck. Then, attack with a unit. If it has the same cost as the discarded card, it gets [+2/+0] for this attack. If it costs more, it gets [+1/+0] instead.
backText:
[Raid 1]
[On Attack:] You may put a unit card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck. If you do, use its [When Played] ability now, as if it were this unit's.
subtitle: Haunted by Dreams
